parsed.title: Discussion on tax filing, domain buying, and app monetization

claims.text: P1 paid ~1000 UAH to correct a declaration after an inspector approved incorrectly for 1.5 years and was later reprimanded.
The main difficulty is not calculating the tax amount but checking each column and subtraction correctly.
The procedure typically takes about an hour with Excel, about one day per month.
The calculator P1 used works only with a hryvnia‑only FOP; otherwise transactions must be converted using the day's exchange rate.
P2 states they have not bought a domain yet.
P4 doubts anyone will buy the domain, calling it a “sira shtuka”.
P4 also remarks that buying the domain isn’t a priority until there are at least ten paying users.

topics.title: Viability of a small‑scale app product

claims.text: P1 outlines many drawbacks of web‑based products (low SEO, no passive ad revenue, harsh paywall, low conversion).
P1 shares a podcast insight: fast delivery (< 1 week), cross‑platform stack (Flutter), and copying popular ideas can work.
P4 argues the project is a “free vibcode” with no real value, only a password hidden in local storage.
P1 sarcastically suggests LinkedIn users could easily hack the app.
P1 asks whether the source code can be found via search for the password.
P4 responds rhetorically, implying they did not pay 299 UAH for it.
P4 says the password is stored “in the bundle”.
